lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's four days? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 4 days? Nope!

lines.text: The grass grows steadily. Ten goats eat it all in twenty days, fifteen goats in ten.
lines.caption: The grass grows steadily. 10 goats eat it all in 20 days, 15 goats in 10.

lines.text: How many days for twenty-five goats?
lines.caption: How many days for 25 goats?

lines.text: Ten goats for twenty days eat two hundred goat-days. Fifteen for ten eat one hundred fifty.
lines.caption: 10 goats for 20 days eat 200 goat-days. 15 for 10 eat 150.

lines.text: The extra fifty grew in ten extra days. That's five goat-days a day!
lines.caption: The extra 50 grew in 10 extra days. That's 5 goat-days a day!

lines.text: Twenty days grow one hundred more. So the starting pile is one hundred.
lines.caption: 20 days grow 100 more. So the starting pile is 100.

lines.text: Five goats eat the new grass. Twenty eat the pile.
lines.caption: 5 goats eat the new grass. 20 eat the pile.

lines.text: One hundred over twenty. That's five days!
lines.caption: 100 over 20. That's 5 days!

lines.text: Four was the trap. It forgets the new grass!
lines.caption: 4 was the trap. It forgets the new grass!

lines.text: Did you get five days? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 5 days? Tell me below!
